description: Na₇AlC₄H₂(O₃F)₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form NaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅F octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₂F₄ octahedra, and edges with four NaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 74°. There are two shorter (2.37 Å) and two longer (2.51 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.30 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form NaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅F octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₂F₄ octahedra, and edges with four NaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 73°. There are two shorter (2.40 Å) and two longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.24 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form NaO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₅F octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₂F₄ octahedra, and edges with four NaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 70-77°. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.30 Å. There are two shorter (2.38 Å) and two longer (2.43 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five O and one F atom to form NaO₅F octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlO₂F₄ octahedra, corners with two NaO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with four NaO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-77°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.57 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.26 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to five O and one F atom to form distorted NaO₅F octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlO₂F₄ octahedra, corners with two NaO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with four NaO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-74°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.52 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.21 Å. Al is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form AlO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₅F octahedra and edges with six NaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-52°. Both Al-O bond lengths are 1.97 Å. All Al-F bond lengths are 1.84 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.26-1.37 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.28-1.32 Å. H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.03 Å) and one longer (1.62 Å) H-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one C, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one C, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Al, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one C atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Al atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Al tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Al atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Al tetrahedra.
